blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Senator Panfilo Lacson on Monday warned that traveling abroad could expose Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa to a greater risk of arrest, as the International Criminal Court (ICC) warrant against the former Philippine National Police chief remains outstanding. In a radio interview, Lacson said seeking refuge overseas could complicate Dela Rosa’s situation because the warrant was issued by an international tribunal rather than a Philippine court. “Pag pumunta siya sa ibang bansa, mas exposed siya. Mas madali siya mahuhuli doon (If he goes to another country, he becomes more exposed. It would be easier to arrest him there),” […]...
